minimum_density_targets.objects: include all structurally relevant artifacts, tools, catalysts, weapons, keys, persistent props, and event-triggering props.
minimum_density_targets.events: include all durable structural events, not only the final scene outcome.
minimum_density_targets.relations: include protagonist-object, protagonist-place, protagonist-concept, object-event, authority/political, and magic/system relations when supported.
minimum_density_targets.unresolved_mentions: include important unresolved actors, objects, concepts, or pronouns rather than silently dropping them.
minimum_density_targets.review: keep uncertain identities in review or local candidate instead of promoting them.
